C0248.title: Man Sentenced in Shaoxing for Selling Pirated Music Bundled on USB Drives
C0248.summary: In September 2022, Xinchang police disclosed an online copyright infringement case. Wang operated an online store and copied unauthorized music works onto USB drives and SD cards for sale, selling more than 4,000 infringing products with sales exceeding RMB 210,000. Police arrested Wang, Qiu, and Yao; Wang and Qiu were both convicted of copyright infringement and received prison sentences with fines.
